record_title: Sharp b-chromatic extremum at fixed order and cycle rank
limitations: The dense-regime minimum-order equality graphs are not classified. The full text of Kouider--Maheo (2002) was not inspected; its relevant size/order bounds were checked through the 2018 survey. The 2026 Zaker preprint was checked at abstract level. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from differently indexed work using excess, circuit rank, cycle rank, or m-degree terminology.
